# Astronomical 0.2.92
Thin Talk, the chat in Astronomical, can now use tools, see the images it makes, and take new messages while it answers.
## What changed
**Thin Talk chat** - Every reply runs through an agent loop, so the model can call tools and use the results in its answer (#1886, #1887). - Tools: the current time, image generation with your local image model, reading a file or describing an image you choose, and searching your past conversations. Tools that touch your files ask first, each time (#1887, #1888, #1889). - A chat model that can see images is shown the images it generates, so it can describe them and spot mistakes (#1891). - You can keep typing while Thin Talk answers, and long conversations are trimmed to fit the model's context window (#1890). - The window uses the native Mac frame and menu bar (#1884). - Right-click a conversation to rename or delete it, drag the sidebar edge to resize it, and text is larger. Opening an old conversation no longer reorders the list (#1891).
**Menu** - The Residency line in the status popover always fits on one line (#1892).
**Reproducible answers** - A request with a `seed` now gives the same answer whether the SSD-streaming (paged) engine or the resident engine runs it, and no longer varies with what the paged engine had warmed up (#1879).
## Compatibility
- Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - Your saved conversations and settings are kept.
## Distribution
- The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID certificate, notarized by Apple and stapled. Updates arrive through the signed Sparkle feed.
